(GI, EG, VT) 

(ZF, XD, CW)
questions.solution:
Move each letter of the first pair back by 2 to form the second pair. Replace each letter of the second pair by its opposite alphabet position to form the third pair. FU gives DS and WH.

**Answer: (FU, DS, WH)**

questions.q: 7 boys P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). V is second to the right of R. U is to immediate left of R. P is third to the right of T. S and T are the immediate neighbours of Q. Who are the immediate neighbours of P?
questions.solution:
Fix R at one seat and place the other boys using the stated clockwise and anticlockwise offsets. The arrangement has P between V and R. Hence V and R are its neighbours.

**Answer: V and R**

questions.q: 7 persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). F is third to the left of A. G is third to the left of F. C is second to the right of F. E is to the immediate left of D. How many persons are sitting between G and C?
questions.solution:
G is at position 1, F at 4 and A at 7. C is second right of F, at position 6. There are four positions between G and C.

**Answer: 4**
